h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bhatpara

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Bhatpara

c: Bhatpara grew up around the jute mills on the east bank of the Hooghly, in North 24 Parganas, and much of the town still lives in closely built mill colonies and wards. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Bhatpara for municipal parks, schools, clubs, housing societies and mill or factory compounds. We build the Fun Fitness machines at our factory in Vasai, about 1,650 km away, and send them by road.

The air near the river is humid for most of the year, and the monsoon is heavy. Painted steel left in these conditions starts to rust within a season or two. Our frames are galvanised pipe and the seats, handles and footplates are roto-moulded plastic, which is the right combination for a wet riverside town. Para clubs and ward committees often have only a narrow strip of land. In that case we plan the stations in a line along the boundary wall.

richText.heading: Fitting a gym into a narrow club ground

c: On a strip of land, single-user machines placed in a row use space better than one large frame. Start with the
for the waist and back, the
wheel for stiff shoulders. Leave enough room in front of each machine for a user to stand and for someone else to walk past. A paved or rubber base stops the area turning to mud in July and August.

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can a para club in Bhatpara buy outdoor gym equipment?
items.a: Yes. Clubs, ward committees and societies can order directly. Send the size of the space and a few photos to sales@funplaysystems.com and we will suggest machines that fit.

items.q: Will the machines rust near the Hooghly?
items.a: The frames are galvanised and the moving parts sit inside sealed housings, so humid air does not rust them the way it rusts painted steel. Rinse off grime and check the bolts every few months.

items.q: Do you install in North 24 Parganas?
items.a: Yes. We dispatch from Vasai by road, and our installation team or a dealer in eastern India sets up the machines, grouted or self-standing depending on your ground.
